name: [Negative] Withdrawal Issues
description: Users across all ratings have reported numerous issues with withdrawing funds from the application. The primary symptoms include delayed or failed withdrawals, inability to withdraw funds, and slow withdrawal processes. Multiple users have experienced these problems on multiple occasions, pointing to a systemic issue.

name: [Negative] Inadequate Customer Support & Withdrawal Issues
description: Users repeatedly report that their withdrawal attempts fail, their funds are blocked or missing, and that customer support is unresponsive, slow, and lacks expertise, leading to frustration and abandonment of the platform.
